changes.messageHandling: Ordinary messages preserve queued and running member tasks, approvals and accepted work; only the explicit interrupt action uses steer. Budget-paused ordinary messages remain queued until Continue or explicit interruption.
changes.handoffDisplay: The per-group handoff switch saves immediately after Host acknowledgement, preserves other setting drafts and hides existing and future handoff/task records while retaining real chat and final files.
changes.controls: Pending actions are scoped to the exact chat/run/generation; pause reasons are localized without mislabeling execution errors as manual pause. Explicit interruption remains usable after reconnect.

finalDelivery.guidance: Final writing replies must provide usable full text; file deliveries must register actual existing final files through present with a brief summary.
finalDelivery.gate: Presenting an already finished file does not require a new work split; existing unfinished plans, same-step delegation, approval, cancellation and file-existence checks still apply.
finalDelivery.cards: Group closing replies retain their exact executor Session and validate the real input claim and completed closing output, then use the public deliverables.files Factory to render the original file cards.
finalDelivery.opening: Preview resolves inside the original worker Session; native actions keep the actual registered Session/event/file coordinates. No arbitrary file:// or model-authored path is promoted into a trusted deliverable.
finalDelivery.visibility: Final file cards remain visible with handoff display off, survive cold history loads and deduplicate repeated registrations.
finalDelivery.persistence: No new Session fields or event types; existing member presentation events remain the source of file records.

changes.windowsCatalog: Generated TypeScript string literals preserve CRLF data while escaping carriage returns; regression verifies both valid output syntax and actual runtime string values.

preserved.petAndStartup: Existing approved companion placement, scale, drag/reset, startup artwork, progress and collapsed startup sidebar were retained.
